design_policy: Preserve the selected original sample. Use only provided color options. Do not rebuild its design.
animation_policy: Animation may be chosen by the renderer provided it preserves the sample's design and composition. Keep the completed invitation readable.
overflow_policy: Shorten or regenerate text; do not shrink fonts or move elements to fit.
implementation_status: Streamlit exports English invitations through original-slide text substitution, LibreOffice rendering and looping GIF encoding. Five category presets have visual smoke checks; the 48-slide source library is retained. Native PowerPoint visual equivalence and all 48 variants have not been verified.
